stage: main artifact reanalysis; fresh network pilots are separate
paper_full_text_status_at_freeze: unavailable: ACM security challenge; KAUST security challenge. Indexed excerpts and author artifacts available. Figure/table mapping remains provisional until full text is inspected.
questions: Does the released test universe contain the reported 156 unique tests?
Can the released aggregate outcome table be recovered from archived worker records under the authors' classifier?
How do preserving missing data and requiring RFC error scope change the apparent classification?
Are client/server, historical-version and translation comparisons based on matched test identities?

hypotheses.criterion: Exactly 156 distinct test IDs 1 through 156, partitioned into 78 client-side and 78 server-side tests.
Exact integer agreement with all 15 rows in the released analysis/tables/result_counts.md. This is artifact numerical reproduction; paper figure agreement is inconclusive until full text review.
Report all classification changes from preserving missing/ambiguous data and error scope; no prespecified direction.

artifact.selection: Every archived results/**/*.json, sorted by path. No ctime-based selection; all datasets retained, primary aggregate row uses sole dataset per proxy where available.

metrics.noncompliance_fraction: percent of classified valid test cases; report unknown and denominator separately
metrics.paired_behavior_difference: counts and percent of common valid test identities; versions/configuration changes are not causally isolated
metrics.error_code: HTTP/2 integer code; do not conflate status 500 with code 5

algorithms: Unmodified upstream analyze_results loaded by AST without executing the plotting campaign
Independent evidence-preserving classifier with explicit unknown state
Broad author conformance rule and strict RFC-scope sensitivity reported separately
configurations: Preserve proxy name, version/commit, TLS and H2EE/H2H1 as separate fields. Missing deployment details, architecture, resource counts and dates remain null. Archived file names are labels, not trustworthy UTC timestamps.
orbital_epochs: not applicable: HTTP/2 empirical protocol compliance study, no satellite simulator
controls: Positive valid request and malformed-frame controls for later network pilots
Independent count conservation and exact ID coverage
Parse all input JSON independently; retain empty, failed and excluded records
Compare against committed table rather than regenerating/overwriting upstream output
sensitivities: Missing/empty/string worker results classified unknown versus authors' dropped
Unrecognized worker states classified unknown versus fallback dropped or mitmproxy unmodified
RST_STREAM versus GOAWAY versus generic HTTP 500 rejection
All archived versions retained rather than latest ctime
replication_unit: Archived dataset for one proxy/configuration; protocol cases and old/new versions are correlated designed cases, not independent random research replicates.
sample_size_rationale: Census of all 57 released JSON datasets and all 156 designed cases. No population-power calculation or confidence intervals justified by this deterministic convenience test suite.
exclusions: Metadata and ID 0 are not experimental test cases; preserve in private raw artifact
Unknown IDs or malformed JSON mark dataset invalid with reason rather than silently discard
Absent expected IDs produce explicit missing measurements
Client-only H2H1 configurations plan only IDs 1-78; never call the server half missing
statistics: Exact counts, proportions and paired identity differences only. No t-test, binomial CI over protocol cases, bootstrap of adjacent observations, or significance-based compliance claim. Sensitivity is a descriptive recoding comparison, not a confidence interval.
comparison_criteria: Equivalent named configuration and identical test IDs. Archived numerical counts can be reproduced; RFC conformance requires response semantics and scope. Nonconformance does not prove exploitability. Full compliance is never established by this finite suite.
out_of_scope: Independent physical multi-network/cloud measurements and cloud geolocation
DoS effectiveness, traffic performance and exploitable vulnerabilities
Historical deployment reconstruction where configs/binaries are absent
Simulator verification (no simulator in this study)
costs: Record wall time and incremental local execution cost (zero additional purchased compute); actual allocated workstation cost unavailable. AWS/model-call bills tracked separately when used. No compute/model budget invented.
followup_rule: Later fresh network experiments get their own frozen protocol and campaign identity; never replace the archived main reanalysis. Scope amendments are versioned and retain this file.
